name: partitioned-review
description: Material-budgeted review of a large repo area: a scout inventories files, the script partitions them into ~35k-estimated-token lanes (line counts × ~10) with an arithmetic coverage assertion, a cross-cutting lane greps the seams, lanes report covered/overflow, failed lanes and overflow are subdivided in a bounded gap-fill pass, and lane reports are merged in batches of eight (reports only — never source material).
